notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.43 — Pipeline tidy-up. Each active candidate has Remove from Pipeline with an optional reason (No longer interested, Unresponsive, Failed checks, Other). Removed candidates move to a dedicated Removed filter without losing personal details, documents, completed checklist steps or candidate history; Restore resumes exactly where they left off. Added Already Hired shortcut for drivers who are already working, moving them directly to Finished without manually ticking old onboarding steps; includes Undo Already Hired. Neither local shortcut changes official MBL or sends a hiring decision. Explicit final Hired/Not Hired actions continue using the verified MBL sync process. Updates are Windows PC/laptop only and local per device, consistent with existing checklist storage. All other workflows remain unchanged.
